claim_checks.claim: Activities form a hierarchy with generalization/allOf and parthood/partOf; partOf children all required, while order and simultaneity are unspecified and overlapping activities are not modeled.

HabitualTrigger links activities to context cues with continuous strength; static SoPrA cue types include object/location/agent/activity, while time cues are deferred; RelatedValue links activity/value with strength.
Belief separates personalStrength from sharedStrength and supports multiple views; same identifies activities for the same bodily movement.
Agent habitRate models heterogeneity in habit acquisition; AdheredValue strength represents personal valuation supporting intentional choice.

Formal rules specify a connected directed tree with unique root; actions are leaves, top action root, other activities abstract; every partOf child requires another sibling partOf child; parent value relation is the mean over children and action/leaf strengths are application-specified; habit relations have no required inheritance; same is an equivalence relation.
The static paper supplies no complete decision/execution loop or dynamic learning transition; time cue and habit learning dynamics are deferred.
Use-case model illustrates commuting, household cues, beliefs, values, and implementations but does not establish predictive behavioral validation.
